chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa narrated to us, from al-Hasan b. Mahbub, from Abdullah b. Sinan. He said: I heard Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) saying:

There are three things that are the pride and adornment of the believer in this world and the Hereafter: prayer in the last part of the night, disregarding that which is in the hands of the people, and the wilaya of the Imam from the Family of Muhammad (may Allah bless him and his family).

key_terms.فخر: Pride, honor; a source of glory for the believer
key_terms.ولاية الإمام: Wilaya of the Imam; accepting the authority and guardianship of the divinely appointed Imam
key_terms.يأسه مما في أيدي الناس: Despair of what is in the hands of people; contentment and not coveting others' possessions

ai.seo_question: What are the three things that are the pride and adornment of a believer?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (as) identifies three qualities that are the pride and adornment of a believer in both this world and the Hereafter: prayer in the last part of the night (tahajjud), having no desire for what is in the hands of other people (contentment and self-sufficiency), and the wilaya (guardianship/authority) of the Imam from the Family of Muhammad (s). These three virtues represent the spiritual, ethical, and doctrinal pillars of a complete believer in Shi'i thought.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from `Abdullah b. Sinan. He said: I heard Aba `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) say:

There are three things that are a pride and adornment for the believer in this world and the Hereafter: (1) prayer at the last part of the night, (2) disregarding that which is in the hands of the people, and (3) wilaya of the Imam from the Family of Muhammad (s).
